content: ब्रह्मण्य {%a.%} [ब्रह्मणे हितः] .²1 Relating to Brahma. .²2 Relating to Brahman or the creator. .²3 Relating to the acquisition of sacred knowledge, holy, pious. .²4 Fit for a Brāhmaṇa. .²5 Friendly or hospitable to a Brāhmaṇa. .{@-ण्यः@} .²1 One well-versed in the Veda; त्वं ब्रह्मण्यः किल परिणतश्चासि धर्मेण युक्तः <ls>Mv. 3. 26</ls>. .²2 The mulberry tree. .²3 The palm tree. .²4 Muñja grass. .²5 The planet Saturn. .²6 An epithet of Viṣṇu. .²7 Of Kārtikeya. .{@-ण्या@} An epithet of Durgā.
